command: python -m pip install --no-deps coverage==7.10.7 && python scripts/run_mypyc_build.py && export PYTEST_PLUGINS= PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1; cd tests/unit && python -m coverage run --branch --source=dank_mids -m pytest; status=$?; python -m coverage json -o /reports/unit-coverage.json; exit "$status"

cgroup_before.memory.events:
low 0
high 0
max 0
oom 0
oom_kill 0
oom_group_kill 0

cgroup_after.memory.events:
low 0
high 0
max 0
oom 0
oom_kill 0
oom_group_kill 0
